scientific_integrity: The positive-definite normalization is f(0)=1 with counting measure on finite square tori. Every proof step, zero-contact case, and strict perturbation is stated; mathematical independence has not been established.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact equality/strictness criterion, not a complete formula for the Turán mass at every nonresonant order; it does not classify all optimizers. The proof uses a published classification of short vanishing root-of-unity sums. Finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Exact divisibility threshold for the Turán mass of a cyclic Lee two-ball
